title: calamagrostis aemula var. plebeia
intro: Calamagrostis aemula var. plebeia, commonly known as Purple Needle Grass, is a species of grass native to Australia and New Zealand. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as arthritis and skin conditions. Its therapeutic actions include soothing and calming effects, which can help reduce stress and anxiety. Bioactive constituents of Purple Needle Grass include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
